scheme_name: Payment of Funeral Assistance for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Applicant must be a registered building/construction worker
Must have been engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant (or nominee) must be a nominee/dependent of a deceased registered member or their spouse
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial assistance of ₹20,000 towards funeral expenses for the nominee/dependent of a deceased registered worker or spouse.
